title: ⚡ Bolt: Replace O(N^2) array_merge with array_push spreading in Zen_SEO_Sitemap
body:
💡 **What**: Replaced `\array_merge()` inside a `foreach` loop in `Zen_SEO_Sitemap` with `\array_push()` and the spread operator `...`.

🎯 **Why**: Using `array_merge()` inside a loop causes a severe performance bottleneck. It has an $O(N^2)$ time complexity because PHP must allocate a brand-new array and copy all existing elements into it during every single iteration. `array_push` with the spread operator modifies the array in-place.

📊 **Impact**: Reduces time complexity of array concatenation from $O(N^2)$ to $O(N)$, significantly lowering memory usage, preventing redundant array allocations, and reducing garbage collection (GC) pauses during sitemap generation.

🔬 **Measurement**: Verify by benchmarking the sitemap generation time and monitoring PHP memory consumption for a large batch of translated posts, ensuring the output array is functionally identical.
